verdict.rationale: DeepSeek is delivered purely as an API compatible with OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs, supporting streaming, JSON mode, function calling, and documented rate-limit/concurrency handling — all of which make it straightforward to script and run headlessly in CI/automation pipelines. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD examples (e.g., GitHub Actions integration) or a dedicated CLI/automation tool beyond generic API/SDK compatibility.
